recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core FHIR. Do not reintroduce the removed core extension files; if future work targets these BDP processing/manipulation extensions, reconcile it in HL7/fhir-extensions.
issue_request: FHIR-16065 was a Published OO change request for BiologicallyDerivedProduct. The final resolution required BDP.processing.procedure to change from CodeableConcept to CodeableReference(Procedure) and required BDP.manipulation.procedure to be added as a 0..* CodeableReference(Procedure).
initial_application: The issue first appeared in the core resource review history in dae319f775, which changed processing.procedure and added manipulation.procedure. After the broader BiologicallyDerivedProduct restructure, ed33c9b5aaa applied FHIR-16065 to the core BDP processing/manipulation extension definitions, preserving processing.procedure as 0..1 CodeableReference(Procedure) and manipulation.procedure as 0..* CodeableReference(Procedure).
additional_context: FHIR-33068 later replaced the BiologicallyDerivedProduct attribute set and explicitly treated processing/manipulation as extension-style content instead of current core backbone elements. December 2021 OO/FMG minutes recorded a check on whether FHIR-16065 had been lost during that restructure. Core commit dd468d4f17 removed the BDP processing/manipulation extension definitions from the R5 source, and the current FHIR Extension Pack contains active BDPProcessing and BDPManipulation definitions with the requested procedure CodeableReference(Procedure) slices. The current core resource remains active in fhir.ini but no longer defines processing or manipulation backbones.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source edit is appropriate because the current core checkout has no in-scope processing/manipulation elements to update, and the authoritative extension-pack definitions already preserve the seed issue's requested cardinality and datatype.

related_jiras.note: Published BDP restructure that removed processing/manipulation from the core backbone shape and explains why the seed issue is now represented through extensions.
